description:
We’re looking for a talented and experienced AI Engineer to join our team and help build the next generation of AI-powered automation and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions.
In this role, you will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Manager, and Business Analysts to research, fine-tune, deploy, and optimize AI services. You will have a strong focus on document understanding, LLM prompt engineering, model fine-tuning, and AI inference optimization.
This is an excellent opportunity for an AI engineer who wants to work on real-world enterprise AI problems and contribute to the development of cutting-edge AI automation products.
* Research, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI/ML models for agentic automation and IDP products.
* Develop OCR/LLM-based solutions for document classification, extraction & validation.
* Optimize LLM applications for cost, latency, accuracy, and scalability.
* Conduct experiments, benchmark models, analyze results, and continuously improve AI model quality and performance.
* Troubleshoot AI model, inference, deployment, and production issues.
* Create technical documentation covering AI models, training processes, prompts, APIs, deployment, and operational procedures.
* Support delivery teams and customers in resolving technical issues related to AI products.
requirements_text:
Required:
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience in OCR/LLM/ML engineering, with strong practical experience delivering AI solutions to production
* Strong practical experience with OCR model training, document understanding, key-value extraction, table extraction.
* Strong experience with LLM system prompts and Prompt Engineering, including structured output, prompt optimization, and reliability improvement.
* Strong experience with Python, PyTorch and HuggingFace.
* Hands-on experience with LLM/VLM fine-tuning, including LoRA, QLoRA, SFT, and multi-GPU training.
* Strong understanding of model evaluation, dataset preparation, training pipelines, and model performance optimization.
* Experience with AI model serving and inference optimization using technologies such as Ollama, vLLM, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server, or ONNX.
* Experience integrating LLM providers such as Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and/or self-hosted LLM models.
* Strong understanding of LLM application architecture, including structured output, function/tool calling, context management, token usage, cost optimization, and latency optimization.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to explain complex concepts to software engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
Nice to have:
* Experience deploying AI services on AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs and building AI-powered web services.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes for deploy production AI workloads.
* Experience with AWS services such as S3, SQS, EC2, ECS/EKS, or GPU computing services.
* Experience with MLOps and CI/CD for AI applications.
* Experience optimizing AI workloads for GPU inference and production-scale deployment.
* Experience with enterprise RPA, IDP or document automation solutions.
